_readme: Edit this file to change the 'On repeat' shelf on cool.html. Each entry needs title + artist; everything else is optional. 'cover' is a path to an image in assets/img/music/ (if omitted, a generated gradient tile is used). 'url' makes the tile clickable. 'note' is your one-liner about it.
heading: On repeat
blurb: What has been in my ears while building all of this.

tracks.title: Replace me
tracks.note: Edit assets/listening.json to put your actual music here.
